sentences.en: Focus on the goal. Everything else is a distraction.
sentences.zh: 专注于目标。其他的一切都是分心的事。

sentences.en: Maria had too many distractions in her day to day life.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚日常生活中有很多让人分心的事情。

sentences.en: He took advantage of my moment of distraction to run away.
sentences.zh: 他趁我走神的时候跑了。

senses.zh: 注意力分散,娱乐，消遣,心烦意乱,精神错乱
